clusters.name: Store Pickup Customer Contact
clusters.reason: Unified backend and frontend changes to implement fallback logic for customer contact details. This ensures that if billing information is missing, the Store Pickup app can retrieve contact details from shipping or order-level records.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Permissions
clusters.reason: Introduction of granular access control for canceling and rejecting transfer order items, moving away from general update permissions to a dedicated cancellation permission.

clusters.name: Webhook Notifications
clusters.reason: Implementation of a secure, HMAC-signed webhook system using Moqui DataFeeds to notify external systems of sales order status changes and item updates.

clusters.name: POS Inventory Management
clusters.reason: Corrections to ship group creation and reservation logic for Point of Sale orders to prevent double inventory deduction and physical stock corruption.

clusters.name: Customer Information Management
clusters.reason: Automatic synchronization of customer first and last names from Shopify during order creation to ensure accurate data for invoices and returns.

clusters.name: Store Pickup Rejection History
clusters.reason: New data views to support the display of order item rejection and facility change history within the Store Pickup application.

clusters.name: Product Synchronization
clusters.reason: Resolution of null reference errors and attribute creation failures during the product synchronization process from Shopify.

clusters.name: Facility Management
clusters.reason: Support for facility operational hours validation and the creation of Solr indexes for facility-based searches.

clusters.name: Inventory Availability
clusters.reason: Support for tracking and updating product availability at specific facilities using the facility identifier.

clusters.name: Order Detail Visualization
clusters.reason: Ensures payment preference data is correctly displayed on order lookup pages within the fulfillment workflow.

clusters.name: Proof of Delivery
clusters.reason: Adjustment of validation constraints for phone numbers within the Proof of Delivery data model.

clusters.name: Data Integrity
clusters.reason: Support for special characters and HTML formatting in notes and attributes to prevent data truncation or display issues.
